note: [LLM critic, medium conf] The AI charges a Battlewagon at a 28% chance with overwatch risk. The expected melee damage is only 6.7 against 12 wounds, so the charge is unlikely to kill it. A failed charge also wastes the unit's turn. Fix: Multiply ch_damage, ch_tie_up_shooter and ch_can_halve by charge_probability. Require charge_probability above the threshold of 0.233 plus a margin when the expected damage is lower than the target wounds. Ignore charge options where the unit cannot reach any objective afterward.
